Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard 



( Reaffirmed 2005 ) 



DIMENSIONS OF VALVE STEM OF 
AIRCRAFT TYRE TUBE VALVES 



1. Scope — Covers basic dimensional requirements of valve stem with the core chamber suitable for 
valves used in aircraft tyre tubes for civil purposes. The valve cores are covered separately. 

2. Dimensional Requirements — The dimensional requirements for valve stem and core chamber shall 
conform to Fig. 1 and 2. If the valve niouth is provided with a counter bore the dimensions shall 
conform to Fig. 3. 

2,1 The position of core pin head and the permissible tolerance shall be in conformity with Fig. 4. 

3. Threads — The threads shall conform to IS ; 9449 (Part l)-1980 'Dimensions for tyre valve threads: 
Part I Threads 5 VI, 5 V2, 6 V1 and 8 VV. 

3.1 The principle of thread gauging shall be in accordance with IS : 2334-1975 'Gauging practice for 
ISO metric screw threads ( first revision )\

Note 2 —The surface shall be smooth to effect sealing with the swivel gasket of the valve cap.

In the preparation of this standard, assistance has been derived from ISO 7442-1982 Tyre 
valves— ISO core .chamber No. 1' and ISO 7295-1982 'Tyre valve — Aircraft interchangeability 
dimensions', issued by the International Organization for Standardization.
